verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP APIs server, enabled under Features > HTTP APIs server, that gives authorized external access to the graph. It also offers a logseq:// protocol for quick capture and community-documented plugin APIs, so an agent can plausibly read and write through the running desktop app. However, the docs do not spell out read/write coverage or truly headless operation, and no MCP server or published API spec is evidenced. One user also reports they can no longer use Claude or Codex to write or update pages on the new DB version. Missing for 10: explicit documented read and write endpoints, headless operation without the desktop app, an official MCP server, an OpenAPI or llms.txt spec, and hands-on corroboration that agents can write via the API on the current version.
